content_sections.heading: NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements - educational qualification, experience and age limit - differ for each post. Details for every post are given below. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for reserved categories. The notification states age will be reckoned as on 31 August 2026.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate from a recognised University/Institute with 55% aggregate marks; proficiency in word processing/database/accounting procedures; 5 years' experience in Establishment/HR section in a large, reputed organization.

Graduate from a recognised University/Institute with 50% aggregate marks; knowledge of typing; knowledge of personal computers and MS Office (certified by a government-recognized institution); minimum 1 year of clerical/correspondence experience in a large, reputed organization.

Passed S.S.C. or equivalent; valid driving license for the required vehicle category (compulsory upload); minimum 3 years of accident-free driving of heavy passenger motor vehicles in large cities; specified physical fitness and eyesight standards apply.

National Trade Certificate (NTC, 60% aggregate) or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC, 60% aggregate) from NCVT in Electronics or an allied trade, with 2 years' (NTC) or 1 year's (NAC) experience in an electronics lab of a reputed organization.

Passed S.S.C. or equivalent; Firefighting Training Certificate/NCC Certificate/Civil Defence training/Home Guard certificate (not applicable to Defence/CAPF candidates); knowledge of personal computers; minimum 3 years' experience in Defence/CAPF/Security work in a reputed organization; specified physical fitness and physical efficiency test standards apply.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications, either online or by post, is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies across 5 post categories: Administrative Assistant-B, Clerk-A, Driver-B, Laboratory Assistant-B (Electronics) and Security Guard.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Clerk-A post in NCRA TIFR?
faq.answer: Clerk-A carries Pay Level 03, Pay Stage 01, with a Total Monthly Emoluments (TME) of Rs. 46,990/- at the Pune HQ and Rs. 39,770/- at the Khodad HQ.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Driver-B post in NCRA TIFR?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years for the Driver-B post at Pune HQ and 35 years for the Driver-B post at Khodad HQ, with age relaxation applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Where are the NCRA TIFR job locations?
faq.answer: The posts are based at Pune and Khodad, though all posts are transferable within NCRA's Pune, Khodad and Ooty campuses.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a written exam for NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify the selection process stages within its own text; it directs candidates to a separate "Selection Procedure" link on the official website.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for NCRA TIFR Recruitment 2026 offline?
faq.answer: Candidates unable to apply online can send a hard copy application in the prescribed format in a sealed cover, marked with the post name, to the Administrative Officer-D (Establishment), NCRA-TIFR, Post Bag 3, Ganeshkhind, Savitribai Phule Pune University Campus, Pune 411007.
